events.title: Nvidia Just Proved ‘AI Efficiency’ Is Fake as Layoffs Rise: ‘The Cost of Compute Is Far Beyond the Cost of Employees’
events.body: Big corporations are using AI investment as an excuse to cut jobs. But according to Nvidia's VP of applied deep learning, the economics behind these mass layoffs don't add up.
